285291866.description:
Mid-Century Wooden Pipe Rack Carousel
Wood and Glass Smoking Pipe Stand with Tobacco Humidor Jar
Mid-Century Modern, Circa 1960s
This vintage pipe caddy features a circular carousel design crafted from stained wood, accommodating up to eight smoking pipes. The center holds a textured green glass humidor jar fitted with a turned wooden lid and round finial knob, offering both pipe storage and tobacco preservation in a classic mid-century design.
Stained wood construction with three turned spindles and eight pipe bowl recesses
Textured green glass tobacco canister with matching wooden lid
Protective felt-lined base; no manufacturer mark visible
Measures approximately 8" in diameter by 5.5" high
Condition:
Good vintage condition. Wood structure is sturdy and stable. Green glass humidor jar is intact with no chips or cracks. Wood surfaces show age-appropriate finish wear, scuffs, and scratches, particularly on the lid and rims. Felt bottom exhibits edge peeling and a small torn section.

284544711.description: This hand-carved wooden wall plaque features a detailed bust of a man with a mustache, wearing a green hat and smoking a pipe. The carving showcases realistic facial features and textured clothing. The back is inscribed with '8. IV Wandertage Ober-Hainbrunn 1941,' indicating it was created as a commemorative piece for an event in Ober-Hainbrunn, Germany. The plaque includes a hole for wall mounting and exhibits vintage condition with signs of age.
